paper.title: Predictive Objectives Discard Exogenous Control-Relevant Features: A Controlled Mechanistic Study

review.question: LeWorldModel 技术谱系中，纯潜空间预测/正则化是否保留控制相关信息，动作敏感性缺失的机制、修复方式、实验边界与迁移条件是什么？

relevance.reason: 该受控研究把 feature controllability 与 reward relevance 正交化，直接检验 reward-free JEPA、action-conditioned JEPA、controllability/inverse-dynamics variants 是否会丢弃不可预测但控制关键的信息，是“预测目标不等于控制充分”的核心反证。

检查未来不可预测 feature 为什么缺少 self-prediction gradient。

检查 linear probe、InfoNCE MI、effective rank 的互补含义与 selective dropping 判据。

MI 仅作主结果 corroboration，未投影独立定量卡。

research_question: 当一个视觉 feature 不受动作控制、其未来值不可预测，却决定 reward/optimal action 时，reward-free latent prediction、action conditioning 或 inverse dynamics 是否会保留它；如果不会，失败来自目标结构还是容量/塌缩，什么监督能修复？
contributions: 以 controllability × reward relevance 四象限和独立 predictability knob，受控隔离 exogenous-but-control-relevant feature。
在 byte-identical encoder 下比较 reconstruction、JEPA、action-conditioned JEPA、controllability JEPA、random-policy inverse dynamics、reward-grounded JEPA 与 supervised reference。
用 probe、InfoNCE MI 与 effective rank 区分选择性丢失和整体 collapse，并以 latent-dimension sweep、两种 surface forms、policy informativeness 与 bisimulation separation 排查替代解释。
显示少量 reward grounding 在该 synthetic setting 中可选择性恢复 relevance，而 pure prediction/controllability signal 不能保证。

method.summary: 构造一个局部视觉 bit，其 controllability、reward relevance 与 temporal predictability 可独立设定；可预测的多频 background 确保 JEPA 有真正的时序结构可学。固定同一 encoder，分别训练六种目标与监督上界，之后在 disjoint evaluation stream 上用 frozen online encoder 做 linear probe、InfoNCE MI 和 effective-rank 诊断，并改变 latent dimension、reward-label fraction、environment surface 与 inverse-dynamics policy informativeness。
assumptions: reward relevance 被设计为 feature bit 直接决定 optimal action/reward，属于立即、二元、局部可见的受控定义。
exogenous feature 的 transition 由 predictability knob 控制；主实验处于最大不可预测设置，background 仍确定性可预测。
linear probe/InfoNCE 可检测 feature retention；effective rank 用于排除全局 collapse，但低 intrinsic-rank environment 需单独解释。
inverse dynamics 的保留能力依赖 behavior policy 的 action 是否与 feature 相关；random-policy 结果不能代表所有 informative policies。
reward-grounded objective 获得 reward labels，而 reward-free variants 不获得；结论比较的是 supervision axis，不是相同信息预算下的纯算法效率。

study_context.sample_or_scale: 小型 synthetic environments；主结果 3 seeds。各 objective 使用 byte-identical encoder，probe 读取 disjoint evaluation seed 上的 online encoder。Bisimulation separation 是 full-training 的 single-seed point estimate。

evaluation.design: 在 feature taxonomy 的四个 cells 上对比目标信号；主 cell 4 在两个 surface forms 上运行，随后做 latent-capacity、reward-fraction、predictability 与 informative-vs-random policy checks。所有 objectives 共享 encoder architecture；JEPA variants 使用统一 anti-collapse regularization，probe 与训练 stream 分离。
baselines: inverse dynamics under random and informative policies

findings.finding: 对于未来接近不可预测但决定 payoff 的 feature，pure self-prediction 没有要求 latent 保留它的梯度；predictability 与 control relevance 可以正交。
findings.scope: 存在性机制建立在显式构造的 binary feature 上，不说明自然数据中该类 feature 的频率。

findings.finding: 所有被测 reward-free predictive variants 在两个环境中都让 exogenous control-relevant feature 接近 chance；reward-grounded、reconstruction 和 supervised references 保留它。
findings.scope: 只针对本文实现和 random-policy failure setting；不是所有可能 objective 的全称结论。
findings.locator: 4.1 Reward-free predictive objectives do not retain the exogenous control-relevant feature

findings.finding: random-policy inverse dynamics 没有 action–feature mutual information 因而不能锚定 cell 4；informative policy 可以保留，但那已引入与 feature 相关的 action supervision。
findings.scope: inverse-dynamics 成败依赖行为策略信息性，不能只按 objective 名称判断。

findings.finding: 扩大 latent dimension 没有让 JEPA 越过保留阈值，而 reward-grounded variant 跨容量保持高保留，支持 objective-structural 而非 encoder capacity 解释。
findings.scope: 容量扫描仍限于小型 synthetic encoder/training budget。
findings.locator: 4.3 The failure is not a capacity problem

findings.finding: JEPA latent 对 cell-4 classes 的 whitened separation 明显小于 reconstruction/supervised references，probe 处于 chance；作者同时明确这是 single-seed controlled measurement 而非定理。
findings.scope: 不能从该结果直接判断大型 pretrained JEPA 或真实控制 regret。

findings.finding: 研究不测试 V-JEPA/LeWM 等大模型、机器人、Atari、RL benchmark 或真实数据，也不估计自然任务中该 failure 的发生频率。
findings.scope: 可支持结构性风险存在和原因隔离，不能支持部署频率或系统排名。

author_stated.limitation: 全部结果来自小型 synthetic environments；未运行大型 pretrained model、机器人、Atari、标准 RL benchmark 或真实演示。
该研究不是 benchmark，也不声称 failure mode 在自然数据中出现的频率。
bisimulation comparison 是 full-training single-seed empirical measurement，不是带环境/学习动力学假设的定理。
inverse-dynamics cell-4 failure 依赖 random actions；informative policy 下不必失败。
objective set 并非穷尽，只能把结论归于本文评测的 reward-free predictive objectives。

reader_inferred.boundary: feature 是局部可见、二元且直接决定即时 reward；自然任务中的隐藏语境、长程规则和连续 reward 可能更难，也可能通过其他相关线索被间接保留。
reader_inferred.basis: 环境实现把 corner/intensity patch 设为 feature bit，并令 optimal action 直接等于该 bit。

reader_inferred.boundary: reward-grounded remedy 的选择性并非免费无监督恢复；它使用 reward labels，改变了监督信息集。
reader_inferred.basis: Table 1/§3.3 明确 jepa_reward consumes reward labels，而其他 predictive variants reward-free。

reader_inferred.boundary: feature probe/MI 表示信息可解码，不等于实际 policy 成功、control regret、安全或恢复能力。
reader_inferred.basis: 全文没有训练/评测下游 controller；bisimulation 与 regret 的联系来自理论引用，当前实证只测 latent separation。

reader_inferred.boundary: 三种指标仍可能受 probe capacity、InfoNCE lower-bound estimator 和 effective-rank calibration 影响。
reader_inferred.basis: 作者专门指出 gridworld intrinsic rank 低，bisimulation measurement 也只有 single seed。

transfer_boundary: 最可信的迁移是结构性告警：若真实任务存在“当前必须观测、未来不可预测、动作不可控制但决定 reward/optimal action”的变量，reward-free prediction、action conditioning 或 inverse dynamics 可能无保留信号。要判断 LeWM/Delta-JEPA 是否受影响，必须在目标数据上构造 reward/exogenous-feature retention、下游 policy 与闭环测试；不能从本 synthetic study 直接判定具体模型失败。

design_strengths: controllability、relevance 与 predictability 被独立操纵，能够隔离“因为不可预测而丢失”而非“因为无关而丢失”。
byte-identical encoder、统一 anti-collapse setup 和 disjoint online-encoder probe 降低架构/探针泄漏混杂。
probe、MI、effective rank 三指标区分 feature omission 与整体 collapse。
两种 surface forms、capacity sweep、reward fraction 和 policy informativeness 检查多个替代解释。
明确列出不蕴含项和 limitations，主张强度总体与受控研究相称。
design_risks: synthetic binary rule 过于简化，且没有大型 pretrained encoder/真实世界复验。
只使用三个 seeds；bisimulation separation 更是 single seed，统计不确定性有限。
reward-grounded 与 reward-free methods 接收不同监督信息，不能解释为纯 objective 优化优越性。
没有下游 policy/control performance，control relevance 通过 reward definition 与 probe retention 间接建立。
objective variants 是统一小环境实现，不等于原始 V-JEPA、LeWM、PLDM 等完整系统。
informative-policy inverse dynamics 可恢复 feature，说明数据收集策略是 load-bearing confounder/condition。
critical_appraisal.baseline_fairness: 共享 encoder、training invariants 和 probe protocol 对目标级比较很公平；但 reconstruction/reward-grounded/supervised references 获得像素或标签信息，角色是信息上界/机制参照，不应当作同监督预算的算法排名。
critical_appraisal.metric_validity: linear probe 与 MI 直接测 feature retention，effective rank 排除 collapse，whitened separation 对接 bisimulation geometry；但这些都不是闭环 controller success 或 regret。InfoNCE 是 lower bound，effective rank 在 intrinsic low-rank 环境需谨慎。
critical_appraisal.reproducibility: 附录列出 byte-identical state_dict assertions、EMA target、anti-collapse regularization、disjoint probe seed、配置 capacity、CUDA/PyTorch、verify.py 与 REPRODUCE.md；当前 HTML 数学节点缺失部分具体值，但结构与复现不变量完整。
critical_appraisal.external_validity: 外部有效性故意受限于小型 synthetic feature-retention setting；向自然视频、长程机器人任务、多模态 hidden state 和具体 LeWM/Delta-JEPA 迁移完全未验证。

evidence_cards.claim: A reward-relevant feature can be temporally unpredictable, in which case a latent self-prediction objective receives no signal to retain information that a controller still needs.
evidence_cards.relation: 指出“预测得好”与“控制信息充分”之间的目标级缺口。
evidence_cards.summary: 引言把 feature 的不可预测性与 payoff relevance 分离，并明确预测目标会把它视为 noise。
evidence_cards.source_context: A self-prediction objective receives no gradient that asks it to carry such a feature: from the objective’s point of view it is noise, even though it determines the agent’s payoff. Predictability and control-relevance, in other words, can be orthogonal, and an objective that optimizes the former can discard a feature that scores high on the latter.

verification.rationale: 连续原文直接说明 no gradient、objective sees noise、feature determines payoff 和 orthogonality；主张限于这种 feature class，没有推成所有预测目标必然失败。

evidence_cards.claim: Across both controlled environments, every evaluated reward-free predictive variant left the exogenous control-relevant feature near chance, while the reward-grounded variant recovered it at the one-bit ceiling alongside reconstruction and supervised references.
evidence_cards.relation: 为 reward-free JEPA/action-conditioned/controllability/inverse-dynamics variants 的共同 retention 缺口提供直接结果。
evidence_cards.summary: 主结果段按两环境和三 seeds 汇总 near-chance predictive variants 与 ceiling reward-grounded/reference outcomes。
evidence_cards.locator: 4.1 Reward-free predictive objectives do not retain the exogenous control-relevant feature
evidence_cards.source_context: All evaluated reward-free predictive objectives leave the exogenous control-relevant feature near chance, in both environments and across three seeds (Figure 2 , Table 2 ). On QuadrantEnv , jepa reaches linear-probe accuracy with mutual information nats; jepa_ac ; jepa_ctrl ; and jepa_invdyn (random policy) , all at chance with essentially zero retained information. In contrast, jepa_reward reaches with nats, the one-bit ceiling, matching the recon and supervised references.

verification.rationale: 精确上下文包含 all evaluated reward-free objectives、both environments、three seeds、at chance/zero information 与 reward-grounded one-bit ceiling；因公式数值缺失，主张不重建具体准确率。

evidence_cards.claim: Inverse-dynamics retention of the exogenous feature depends on the behavior policy: random actions provide no anchor, whereas an informative policy can retain it only because actions correlate with the feature.
evidence_cards.relation: 限定把 inverse dynamics/LDAD 视为普遍控制相关信息修复器的范围。
evidence_cards.summary: Objectives section 明确区分 random-policy failure 与 informative-policy rescue，并把后者归为 action supervision。
evidence_cards.source_context: For jepa_invdyn the policy matters. Under the random-policy stream used in the failure experiments, the actions carry no information about an exogenous feature, so the inverse-dynamics head has nothing to anchor cell 4 to and drops it. Under an informative policy whose actions correlate with the feature (the condition shown in the full matrix, Table 3 in Appendix C ), the same objective can retain it. But that is ground-truth action supervision, not unsupervised rescue.

verification.rationale: 原文逐项包含 policy matters、random actions no information/no anchor、informative correlated actions retain 与 not unsupervised rescue；主张不否认 informative-policy 条件。

evidence_cards.claim: Increasing latent capacity did not rescue cell-4 retention for JEPA, while the reward-grounded variant remained high across the sweep, supporting an objective-structural rather than capacity explanation.
evidence_cards.relation: 排除“LeWM/JEPA 只是 latent 太小”的替代解释。
evidence_cards.summary: capacity sweep 显示 JEPA 始终不过 retain threshold，reward-grounded variant 跨容量保持近完美。
evidence_cards.locator: 4.3 The failure is not a capacity problem
evidence_cards.source_context: Increasing latent capacity does not rescue the feature for JEPA. As the latent dimension grows from to , JEPA’s cell-4 linear-probe accuracy moves only from to on QuadrantEnv and never crosses the retain threshold (Figure 3 , Table 4 ). The slight upward drift at very large dimensions is small and plausibly reflects marginal saturation of the covariance regularizer rather than genuine retention. jepa_reward holds at from dimension through and dips to ( Quadrant ) or ( SwitchColor ) only at , a training-budget artifact at the largest scale rather than a capacity floor. The cell-4 failure to retain is a property of the objective, not of the encoder’s size.

verification.rationale: 该段直接表述 capacity does not rescue、never crosses retain threshold、reward-grounded stays high 与 objective not size；数学值不可见，因此卡片只保留方向。

evidence_cards.claim: The trained JEPA latent realized substantially less class separation for the exogenous reward-relevant feature than reconstruction and supervised references, but the authors characterize this as a single-seed controlled measurement rather than a theorem or large-model result.
evidence_cards.relation: 用 bisimulation-aware geometry 补充 probe 结果，同时保留证据强度和外推边界。
evidence_cards.summary: Section 5 把 analytical reward-sensitive state distinction与实际 latent separation 对比，并明示 single seed、finite budget、large pretrained generality open。
evidence_cards.source_context: Only the supervised reference and the pixel-grounded reconstruction baseline realize that separation in latent space (class distance ); the JEPA latent realizes only (Figure 5 ). In our setting, latent self-prediction provides no effective optimization signal toward the unpredictable-but-relevant feature and does not encode it, even though it is trivially encodable. These numbers are a single-seed point estimate under full training and are reported as such. Zhang et al. ( 2020 ) relate bisimulation-aligned representations to lower control regret: a representation that fails to separate states differing in a reward-relevant feature cannot support a controller that acts on it. This comparison locates exactly such a failure: the near-zero class separation is measured directly from the latent geometry, so the loss of control-relevant structure is intrinsic to the representation rather than an artifact of any particular probe or downstream policy. We emphasize that this comparison is an empirical measurement in a controlled synthetic environment, not a formal proof; the analytical bisimulation distance is a closed-form derivation, but the claim that JEPA does not encode the feature is measured from trained models on a finite budget, and its generality to large pretrained JEPA models is an open question.

verification.rationale: 连续上下文支持 less separation、single-seed、controlled empirical measurement/not proof 与 large-model open question；主张没有将理论引用中的 regret 关系当成本篇实测 controller 结果。

evidence_cards.claim: The study establishes an objective-level failure mode only in small synthetic environments; it does not test large pretrained models, robotics, standard RL benchmarks, real data, or how often the failure occurs naturally.
evidence_cards.relation: 界定该反证对 LeWorldModel/Delta-JEPA 的用途是风险假设与测试设计，而非具体模型判决。
evidence_cards.summary: Limitations section 明确列出 synthetic-only、无大模型/机器人/Atari/真实数据和非 benchmark/频率结论。
evidence_cards.source_context: We are deliberately explicit about scope: this is a controlled mechanistic study, not a benchmark and not a theorem. • All results are in small synthetic environments ( and observations). We run no large-scale pretrained-model experiments (e.g. V-JEPA 2-AC), no robotics experiments, no Atari or other standard RL-benchmark experiments, and no real-world demonstrations; transfer to any of these is untested and is future work. • This is not a benchmark study. We do not rank methods on a task suite and make no claim about how frequently the failure mode arises in natural data, only that it exists and has an identifiable cause.

verification.rationale: 原文逐字声明 controlled/not benchmark/not theorem、small synthetic、no large model/robotics/Atari/real demonstrations 与 no natural-frequency claim；卡片完全按明示范围表述。

core_citations.title: Learning Invariant Representations for Reinforcement Learning without Reconstruction
core_citations.reason: 提供 bisimulation-aware representation 与 control-relevant state distinction 的理论对照，是 Section 5 separation 解释的关键外部前提。
